title: Acoustic Respiratory Phase Detection on Mobile Devices
abstract: arXiv:2611.16710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Breathing monitoring is important for well-being, stress regulation, and guided breathing exercises, yet existing approaches often rely on contact-based sensors or controlled environments. This paper presents a non-invasive framework for respiratory phase detection using acoustic signals recorded on commodity smartphones. The proposed hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture combines local spectral feature extraction with long-range temporal modeling to capture the cyclic structure of breathing. The model is evaluated using a Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) protocol on the Foundation Dataset and on an independent unseen test set comprising over 1300 breathing cycles and 2 hours of continuous recordings. The proposed 3-class formulation achieves 72.85% frame-level accuracy and 96.6% cycle-level exhalation detection efficiency in the LOSO evaluation, while achieving 76.94% frame-level accuracy, a Cohen's Kappa score of 0.65, and 99.2% cycle-level

translated_title: 移动设备上的声学呼吸相位检测
translated_abstract: 呼吸监测对于健康、压力调节和引导式呼吸练习非常重要，但现有方法通常依赖于接触式传感器或受控环境。本文提出了一种基于普通智能手机录制的声学信号进行呼吸相位检测的无创框架。所提出的混合CNN-Transformer架构将局部频谱特征提取与长程时间建模相结合，以捕捉呼吸的周期性结构。该模型在Foundation Dataset上采用留一被试（LOSO）协议进行评估，并在一个包含超过1300个呼吸周期和2小时连续录音的独立未见测试集上进行验证。所提出的三分类方案在LOSO评估中实现了72.85%的帧级准确率和96.6%的周期级呼气检测效率，同时在未见测试集上实现了76.94%的帧级准确率、0.65的Cohen's Kappa系数以及99.2%的周期级呼气检测效率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于智能手机声学信号的无创呼吸相位检测框架，采用混合CNN-Transformer架构捕捉呼吸周期结构，在留一被试评估中实现72.85%的帧级准确率和96.6%的周期级呼气检测效率。
en_tdlr: A non-invasive acoustic respiratory phase detection framework on commodity smartphones using a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture, achieving 72.85% frame-level accuracy and 96.6% cycle-level exhalation detection efficiency in LOSO evaluation.
